head_commit.message:
Say why a failed review failed (#4)

* Say why a failed review failed, in the log and the gate comment

claude-code-action logs only a sanitized result, so a failed review showed
"no valid review output" with no cause. A step that runs only when the
review step fails reads the action's execution file, logs the final
result's subtype, is_error and error text as one printable line of at most
300 characters, and hands that line to report, which puts it in the
no-review reason. The prompt, the diff and model text from a run without an
error are never read out. The text is untrusted: it reaches a shell only
through env and the comment only as inline code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Log the failure reason with workflow commands stopped; one reason limit

The runner also runs legacy `##[command]` text found anywhere in a log
line, so an error text such as `##[add-mask]...` could hide the reason or
add annotations. The reason is now printed between `::stop-commands::` and
its random resume token. The 300-character limit has one owner,
verdict.REASON_LIMIT, used for the cut and the comment, and tests pin it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Record the legacy workflow-command lesson

Bound gate jobs at 60 minutes; add the agent learnings log (#2)

The gate now runs on a dedicated runner with no job-started hold, so a
job no longer waits hours for a host. Each working step keeps its own
short timeout. AGENT_LEARNINGS.md records a confirmed agent mistake for
the next run.

commit.message:
Review critical-path PRs in shadow; several agent branch prefixes (#3)

* Review PRs on critical paths too; allow several agent branch prefixes

A PR whose only finding is a critical path now gets the model review,
and the verdict stays "needs a human" whatever the review says, so
shadow mode measures the reviewer on the riskiest PRs. Any other
assessment reason still skips the review. The config key
`agent_branch_prefix` becomes the list `agent_branch_prefixes`
(default `["ai/"]`), so a project can also accept `claude/` branches.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Never review a PR that edits agent config; record the reviewer's own verdict

The review session loads skills, commands and agents from pr-head/.claude through --add-dir, so agent config gets its own reason that skips the review. The comment record gains review: merge | manual | null for shadow analysis.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Treat a .claude symlink as agent config

git and GitHub list a symlink as one file, so .claude or sub/.claude alone matched no glob and a PR could point the reviewer's skill directories at its own files.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Load only user settings in the review session

--setting-sources user keeps project skills, commands, agents, settings and CLAUDE.md of both checkouts out of the reviewer, so agent config reached through a default-branch symlink or an import cannot steer it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Say why a failed review failed (#4)

* Say why a failed review failed, in the log and the gate comment

claude-code-action logs only a sanitized result, so a failed review showed
"no valid review output" with no cause. A step that runs only when the
review step fails reads the action's execution file, logs the final
result's subtype, is_error and error text as one printable line of at most
300 characters, and hands that line to report, which puts it in the
no-review reason. The prompt, the diff and model text from a run without an
error are never read out. The text is untrusted: it reaches a shell only
through env and the comment only as inline code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The runner also runs legacy `##[command]` text found anywhere in a log
line, so an error text such as `##[add-mask]...` could hide the reason or
add annotations. The reason is now printed between `::stop-commands::` and
its random resume token. The 300-character limit has one owner,
verdict.REASON_LIMIT, used for the cut and the comment, and tests pin it.

+"""Say why the review step failed, from claude-code-action's execution file.
+
+The action logs only a sanitized result (subtype, is_error, cost), so a failed review would show no
+cause. The file holds every message, the prompt and the diff included; this reads only the final
+result message. Its text comes from the model or the API and may echo PR content, so the reason is
+one printable line, which cannot add a `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` key, logged with workflow commands stopped.
+"""
+
+import json
+import os
+import secrets
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .verdict import REASON_LIMIT
+
+
+def _line(text: str) -> str:
+    return " ".join("".join(c if c.isprintable() else " " for c in text).split())
+
+
+def failure_reason(messages) -> str:
+    """The final result's subtype, is_error and error text; no model text when it reported no error."""
+    if not isinstance(messages, list):
+        return "no result message"
+    results = [m for m in messages if isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("type") == "result"]
+    if not results:
+        return "no result message"
+    result = results[-1]
+    subtype = result.get("subtype") if isinstance(result.get("subtype"), str) else "unknown"
+    is_error = result.get("is_error") is True
+    reason = f"subtype {subtype}, is_error {'true' if is_error else 'false'}"
+    if is_error or subtype != "success":
+        errors = result.get("errors")
+        if isinstance(result.get("result"), str):
+            reason += f": {result['result']}"
+        elif isinstance(errors, list):
+            reason += ": " + "; ".join(e for e in errors if isinstance(e, str))
+    else:
+        reason += ": no structured output"
+    return _line(reason)[:REASON_LIMIT].rstrip()
+
+
+def reason_from_file(path: str) -> str:
+    if not path:
+        return "no execution file"
+    try:
+        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+        return "execution file unreadable"
+    try:
+        messages = json.loads(text)
+    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
+        return "execution file is not JSON"
+    return failure_reason(messages)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    reason = reason_from_file(argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else "")
+    # The runner also runs legacy `##[command]` text found anywhere in a line, so the reason is
+    # printed with workflow commands stopped; the random token cannot appear in it.
+    token = secrets.token_hex(16)
+    print(f"::stop-commands::{token}\nmerge-gate: review failed: {reason}\n::{token}::")
+    with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as out:
+        out.write(f"reason={reason}\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

+SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+MUTANTS = [
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", "glob = first_match(config.critical, path)", "glob = None"),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", "return pr.author == config.owner and", "return True or"),

+    ("merge_gate/verdict.py", 'if not review.criteria and not deps:', "if False:"),
+    ("merge_gate/verdict.py", 'return f"`{text}`" if text else "(empty)"', "return text"),
+    ("merge_gate/verdict.py", "ok = isinstance(v, list) and all(", "ok = all("),
+    ("merge_gate/verdict.py", 'ok = type(v) is int and spec["minimum"] <= v', 'ok = isinstance(v, int) and spec["minimum"] <= v'),
+    ("merge_gate/github.py", 'c["user"]["login"] == COMMENT_AUTHOR and ', ""),
+    ("merge_gate/github.py", 'and head["repo"]["full_name"] == self.repo', ""),
+    ("merge_gate/config.py", 'if raw["mode"] != "shadow":', "if False:"),
+    ("merge_gate/config.py", 'globs("critical_paths", BUILTIN_CRITICAL, ignore_case=True)', 'globs("critical_paths", (), ignore_case=True)'),
+    ("merge_gate/config.py", 'BUILTIN_CRITICAL, ignore_case=True)', 'BUILTIN_CRITICAL, ignore_case=False)'),
+    ("merge_gate/config.py", 'type(raw["version"]) is not int or ', ""),
+    ("merge_gate/globs.py", 'if pattern.startswith(("/", "!", "./"))', 'if False and pattern.startswith(("/", "!", "./"))'),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", "MAX_DIFF_FILES = 300", "MAX_DIFF_FILES = 3000"),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", "(f.status is FileStatus.RENAMED and was_test)", "(f.status is FileStatus.RENAMED and not first_match(config.tests, f.path))"),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", 'r"v?([0-9]{1,9})\\.([0-9]{1,9})\\.([0-9]{1,9})"', 'r"v?(\\d{1,9})\\.(\\d{1,9})\\.(\\d{1,9})"'),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", 'r"(?<![\\w.$])" + ', ""),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", '"pytest.importorskip(",', ""),
+    ("merge_gate/__main__.py", '("pull_request", "push")', '("pull_request",)'),
+    ("merge_gate/bun.py", "if digest != SHA256:", "if False:"),
+    ("merge_gate/globs.py", '("/", "!", "./")', '("/", "!")'),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", '    "//go:build",\n', ""),
+    ("merge_gate/assess.py", '"fdescribe(", "skip(")', '"fdescribe(")'),
+    ("merge_gate/verdict.py", "except (ValueError, RecursionError):", "except json.JSONDecodeError:"),
+]
+
+failed = 0
+for rel, old, new in MUTANTS:
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        work = Path(tmp) / "repo"
+        shutil.copytree(SRC, work, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns(".git", ".venv", ".hypothesis", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache"))
+        target = work / rel
+        text = target.read_text()
+        if text.count(old) != 1:
+            print(f"BAD MUTANT (pattern count {text.count(old)}): {rel}: {old}")
+            failed += 1
+            continue
+        target.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
+        r = subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-x", "-p", "no:cacheprovider"],
+            cwd=work, capture_output=True, text=True,
+        )
+        caught = r.returncode != 0
+        print(f"{'caught ' if caught else 'SURVIVED'} {rel}: {old[:60]}")
+        failed += not caught
+sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)

commit.message:
Say why a failed review failed, in the log and the gate comment

claude-code-action logs only a sanitized result, so a failed review showed
"no valid review output" with no cause. A step that runs only when the
review step fails reads the action's execution file, logs the final
result's subtype, is_error and error text as one printable line of at most
300 characters, and hands that line to report, which puts it in the
no-review reason. The prompt, the diff and model text from a run without an
error are never read out. The text is untrusted: it reaches a shell only

+"""Say why the review step failed, from claude-code-action's execution file.
+
+The action logs only a sanitized result (subtype, is_error, cost), so a failed review would show no
+cause. The file holds every message, the prompt and the diff included; this reads only the final
+result message. Its text comes from the model or the API and may echo PR content, so the reason is
+one printable line, which cannot add a `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` key, logged with workflow commands stopped.
+"""
+
+import json
+import os
+import secrets
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .verdict import REASON_LIMIT
+
+
+def _line(text: str) -> str:
+    return " ".join("".join(c if c.isprintable() else " " for c in text).split())
+
+
+def failure_reason(messages) -> str:
+    """The final result's subtype, is_error and error text; no model text when it reported no error."""
+    if not isinstance(messages, list):
+        return "no result message"
+    results = [m for m in messages if isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("type") == "result"]
+    if not results:
+        return "no result message"
+    result = results[-1]
+    subtype = result.get("subtype") if isinstance(result.get("subtype"), str) else "unknown"
+    is_error = result.get("is_error") is True
+    reason = f"subtype {subtype}, is_error {'true' if is_error else 'false'}"
+    if is_error or subtype != "success":
+        errors = result.get("errors")
+        if isinstance(result.get("result"), str):
+            reason += f": {result['result']}"
+        elif isinstance(errors, list):
+            reason += ": " + "; ".join(e for e in errors if isinstance(e, str))
+    else:
+        reason += ": no structured output"
+    return _line(reason)[:REASON_LIMIT].rstrip()
+
+
+def reason_from_file(path: str) -> str:
+    if not path:
+        return "no execution file"
+    try:
+        text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+        return "execution file unreadable"
+    try:
+        messages = json.loads(text)
+    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
+        return "execution file is not JSON"
+    return failure_reason(messages)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    reason = reason_from_file(argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else "")
+    # The runner also runs legacy `##[command]` text found anywhere in a line, so the reason is
+    # printed with workflow commands stopped; the random token cannot appear in it.
+    token = secrets.token_hex(16)
+    print(f"::stop-commands::{token}\nmerge-gate: review failed: {reason}\n::{token}::")
+    with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as out:
+        out.write(f"reason={reason}\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

+import json
+
+from hypothesis import given
+from hypothesis import strategies as st
+
+from merge_gate import failure
+
+PROMPT = "Review this PR. PROMPT-TEXT"
+DIFF = "+DIFF-LINE secret-looking"
+LIMIT_TEXT = "Claude AI usage limit reached|1761523200"
+
+
+def execution(result):
+    """The shape claude-code-action@925afb53 writes: every SDK message, prompt and diff included."""
+    return [
+        {"type": "system", "subtype": "init", "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "tools": ["Read"]},
+        {"type": "user", "message": {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": PROMPT + DIFF}]}},
+        {"type": "assistant", "message": {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Looking at " + DIFF}]}},
+        {"type": "result", "duration_ms": 1017, "num_turns": 1, "total_cost_usd": 0, "modelUsage": {}, **result},
+    ]
+
+
+# Run 40367941066, attempt 1: the action logged only these fields and the error text was lost.
+RECORDED = execution({"subtype": "success", "is_error": True, "result": LIMIT_TEXT})
+
+
+def run_main(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, content):
+    path = tmp_path / "claude-execution-output.json"
+    path.write_text(content)
+    out = tmp_path / "GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+    out.write_text("")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("GITHUB_OUTPUT", str(out))
+    assert failure.main(["x", str(path)]) == 0
+    return capsys.readouterr().out, out.read_text()
+
+
+def logged_reason(log):
+    """The reason line, which must sit between a stop-commands line and its resume line."""
+    stop, line, resume = log.split("\n")[:-1]
+    token = stop.removeprefix("::stop-commands::")
+    assert len(token) == 32 and resume == f"::{token}::" and token not in line
+    return line
+
+
+def test_a_recorded_error_result_gives_its_text_and_nothing_else(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    log, output = run_main(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, json.dumps(RECORDED))
+    reason = f"subtype success, is_error true: {LIMIT_TEXT}"
+    assert logged_reason(log) == f"merge-gate: review failed: {reason}"
+    assert output == f"reason={reason}\n"
+    for text in (log, output):
+        assert "PROMPT-TEXT" not in text and "DIFF-LINE" not in text
+
+

+    messages = execution({"subtype": "success", "is_error": True, "result": text})

+

A failed review now says why. The review job logs the final result's subtype, `is_error` and error text, and the gate comment shows `no-review: <reason>` instead of only `no valid review output`. Trigger: dotfiles run 40367941066 failed in 1 s with `is_error: true` and the cause was lost.

## How
- A `failure` step runs only when the Claude step fails and reads only the last `result` message of the action's `execution_file`: never the prompt, the diff, or model text from a run without an error.
- The reason is untrusted: one printable line of at most 300 characters, logged with workflow commands stopped, passed only through `env` and job outputs, shown as inline code.

## Acceptance criteria
- A recorded is_error result gives `subtype success, is_error true: <text>` in the log and the comment: `test_a_failed_review_puts_its_reason_in_the_comment`.
- Error subtypes, a run without an error, and missing or broken files each give a fixed reason: `tests/test_failure.py`.
- Hostile text (`::`, `##[`, Markdown) stays inert: Hypothesis property plus example tests.
- No `run:` line interpolates `${{`: `tests/test_workflow.py`.
- `pytest -q` 78 passed, `mutation-check.py` 51 caught, `actionlint` clean. `zizmor --offline` has one low finding, the same as on `main`.

Not verified live: no review has failed yet on a runner with this code.

## Callers
dotfiles and Proxi-Labs/vinipuch pin `0905c8c`. Moving those pins, with the matching allowed-actions entries in both repositories and the Proxi-Labs organization, is a separate step for the owner to approve.

**Rollback:** revert this PR. Pinned callers are unaffected.
**Failure detection:** the step's log line `merge-gate: review failed: ...`. If the step breaks, the comment falls back to `no valid review output`.

The gate now reviews PRs whose only finding is a critical path, and it accepts several agent branch prefixes. The aim is more shadow data from Vinipuch, where 36 of the last 40 PRs touch a critical path.

- **Critical paths still get the review.** When a critical path is the only assessment reason, the review runs, but the verdict stays "needs a human" whatever the review says. Any other reason (draft, not a candidate, CI not green, too large, a test removed, a skip marker) still skips the review.
- **Agent config is never reviewed.** It now has its own reason, `agent-config`. It covers `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `AGENTS.md` and `.claude` at any depth, a `.claude` symlink included, plus `.mcp.json`. The reviewer would otherwise load skills, commands and agents from the PR head. `BUILTIN_CRITICAL` is now `.github/**` only.
- **The reviewer loads only user settings.** It runs with `--setting-sources user`, so project settings, skills, agents and CLAUDE.md from either checkout stay out of it.
- **Config change.** `agent_branch_prefix` (a string) becomes `agent_branch_prefixes` (a list, default `["ai/"]`). The old key is refused; nothing uses it yet.
- **Comment record.** It gains `review: merge | manual | null`, the reviewer's own call, which the shadow analysis needs.

Checks:
- `pytest`: 62 passed.
- `scripts/mutation-check.py`: 41 of 41 mutants caught.
- `actionlint` is clean. `zizmor --offline` reports only the known low self-repository note.
- The three new behaviour tests fail against main and pass here.
- Three review rounds ran:
  - Round 1: no blocking finding. It raised that agent config would load into the reviewer, which is now fixed.
  - Round 2: one blocking finding, the `.claude` symlink, now fixed.
  - Round 3: no blocking finding.
- The owner chose to merge without a fourth round on the `--setting-sources user` line. It gets its live check on the next gate run. If it breaks the session, the gate fails closed with "needs a human: no-review".

Gate jobs time out after 60 minutes instead of 360.

The 360-minute job timeout existed for a self-hosted runner whose job-started hook could hold a job while the host was busy. The gate now runs only on a dedicated runner without that hold, so a stuck job is now freed within an hour. The working steps keep their own timeouts (10, 5, 30 and 10 minutes), so the job timeout only bounds runner setup.

Also adds `AGENT_LEARNINGS.md`, the agent mistakes log for this repository.
